original_card.question: Can an explicitly larger or nonabelian register model escape the scoped three-register obstruction?
methods: Construct the smallest exact identity in a newly specified legal operation alphabet.
Derive a target-specific relaxation bound for that same explicit alphabet.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Name the changed hypothesis, all counted roles and a uniform identity; finite column tests alone do not certify it.

first_step.inspect: Read Model section 1 of the three-register bound and identify the exact excluded free operations.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Write a complete operation alphabet outside one named premise and price a baseline before searching identities.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A small-width completed saving changes the bit primitive; a finite-address identity alone is insufficient.
allowed_variations: Choose a fixed larger register count or a specified nonabelian operation family.
scope_change_triggers: Remaining inside the already-excluded three-register abelian model.

actual_scope: In M3(F2[SL2(F3)]), with i=[[0,1],[-1,0]] and w=[[0,-1],[1,-1]] over F3, use the four paid address labels i,i^-1,w,w^-1 and all 28 rank-one idempotents N in M3(F2). Determine the exact minimum paid-call count for diag([i],[w],[w^-1 i w]), with free scalar GL3(F2) interleavings allowed, by exhausting every word through depth four and comparing with the direct five-call word.
scope_change_reason: The catalogue explicitly permits a specified nonabelian operation family. This refines that broad option to the order-24 binary tetrahedral group SL2(F3), its four-generator alphabet, and one heterogeneous three-role endpoint so the full search through one call below the direct bill is finite and exactly coverable.
bottleneck_link: A four-call factorization would remove one paid call from this five-call finite bit-register endpoint. The exact minimum is five, so this particular nonabelian extension supplies no saving. The model does not price any selected-supplier source, hosting, or physical address-operation implementation, and no kappa change follows.
stop_rule: Exhaust all words of lengths zero through four over the 112 paid factors in M3(F2[SL2(F3)]), with exact full-coefficient equality, and verify the direct five-call endpoint and controls. Do not expand to a different group, target, or register count in this cycle.
evidence: SL2(F3) has 24 elements and is generated by i,w. There are 28 rank-one idempotents and 112 paid factors. Exact meet-in-the-middle coverage checks every word of lengths 0..4 (112^k raw words at length k): the 12,544 two-call words yield 8,905 distinct exact states, each checked as a suffix for both 1+2 and 2+2 splits. The two-call transition is cross-checked against full group-algebra convolution for all 12,544 pairs. No target hit occurs through four calls; the direct five-call word realizes diag([i],[w],[w^-1 i w]), so the exact minimum is five in this model. Five omitted-call controls, a generator mutation, a two-call positive control, all gate inverses, and all group-table associativity checks pass.
